decision.observation: Thursday the 11th, 7:40 p.m.; the farmer has advanced east along the cobblestone road to a northbound path beside a bench, with graves and bushes below.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing east on the same road should reach the river bridge; from there, a southbound route may lead to the Fish Shop and beach.
decision.memory: Eastward movement now works when the farmer is centered on the southern cobblestone road. Target: Fish Shop at the southeast beach; Willy's promised-item meeting remains unresolved. Funds are 218g.
